PairScreen.title: Pair with Frank

PairScreen.noCameraHere: Scanning needs a camera. Paste the link instead.
PairScreen.cameraRefused: The camera is turned off for Frank. Turn it on in Settings, or paste the link instead.
PairScreen.clipboardUnavailable: Frank could not read the clipboard here. Paste the link into the box above instead.

PairScreen.noAddress: That pairing code carries no address — the machine could not find one to offer.

SettingsDialog.computerControlBody: Computer control needs Accessibility access to read and drive other apps on this Mac.
SettingsDialog.computerControlHint: Let the assistant control apps on this Mac — click, type, and navigate — for things that have no API. Needs Accessibility access; each action stays contained to one app.
SettingsDialog.dictationHint: Speak into the composer instead of typing. Transcribed on this Mac — nothing is sent anywhere — but the first use downloads about a gigabyte of model weights.
SettingsDialog.discardBody: Some fields have unsaved or incomplete values. Closing settings will discard them.
SettingsDialog.filesystemProtectionUnavailable: This machine has no confinement backend, so sessions will refuse to start unless this is turned off.
SettingsDialog.firecrawlApiKeyHint: Fallback engine for pages Jina can't render.
SettingsDialog.fullDiskAccessBody: Screen Time and Safari history need Full Disk Access.
SettingsDialog.jinaApiKeyHint: Web fetch works without one; a key raises the rate limit.
SettingsDialog.proxyServerHint: Routes web fetches and downloads through a proxy for IP-blocked sites.
SettingsDialog.restartBody: Frank needs to restart for the Accessibility permission to take effect — the daemon re-reads it only on a fresh start. Your sessions are kept: each one loses its process and picks back up where it left off on the next message. Computer control turns on automatically once it does.
SettingsDialog.title: Settings
SettingsDialog.userContextHint: Share a snapshot of how you work — frequent folders, recent files, apps, and sites — so the assistant fits your habits. Off by default; stays on this machine.
